text:
Priya R.: Reporting a customer escalation (acct: acme-corp). They hit parser errors when using structured/json mode after our recent smart-routing change. Error: 'invalid JSON at position 1'. Only occurs when request routed to eu-west quantized variant.

Jordan K.: Can you paste the raw model output + request id?

Priya R.: Request id: req_0a1b2c. Raw response:
```json
Note: model served with quantized-fallback
{
  "items": [
    {"id": "1", "value": "foo"}
  ]
}
```

Priya R.: Notice the 'Note:' preface — client JSON parser chokes because it's not valid JSON.

Marta S.: That's odd, quantized variants shouldn't add human-readable prefaces. Might be a generation-safety policy that adds a comment when logits clipped.

Lee W.: Do we have routing metadata? Maybe the router is appending context for debugging.

Priya R.: Header we received: `x-routing-path: smart->quant8-eu-west`. Full curl used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"mode":"json","prompt":"...","request_id":"req_0a1b2c"}'
```

Jordan K.: Repro steps for eng: use that curl + pin model to quant8-eu-west, run many times; looks intermittent.

Marta S.: I can repro locally when quantized model hits coverage low; our fallback policy adds an explanatory sentence to the assistant output. Shouldn't do that for strict-json mode.

Lee W.: Short-term mitigation: add router-side sanitizer that strips leading non-JSON token(s) when clients request structured mode; also surface an error code so clients can retry.

Priya R.: Customer is blocked; they parse strictly. Can we patch today?

Jordan K.: I'll push a hotfix on the router to reject fallbacks to variants that are not 'json-safe' for structured outputs. If not possible, route to primary compatible model or return 409/RETRY.

Marta S.: I'll update the variant policy to set `structured_output_allowed=false` when generator can add free-text prefixes.

incident-bot: Ticket INC-2026 opened for acme-corp escalation, priority=P1.

Lee W.: Action items: Jordan - router patch (2h), Marta - policy flag/backfill (4h), Priya - keep customer updated. I'll own postmortem if this becomes more widespread.

Priya R.: Thanks all, sending update to customer: we have a patch rolling.

Jordan K.: Patch deployed to staging; running canary against acme account now.

Priya R.: Canary passed, pushing to prod. Customer confirms parser OK. Closing for now but we should automated test guard for structured mode.

Marta S.: Agreed — adding unit tests that validate outputs from fallback variants are strict JSON when client's mode=json.

Lee W.: I'll add a console alert when router sends fallback to a variant with `structured_output_allowed=false`.

Priya R.: Closing thread once postmortem is up. :thumbsup:
